description: Audit the JSON-LD a supplied page declares against a contract the caller states. Entities inside @graph and nested inside other entities are flattened first, because reading only the top level misses every entity a real page declares that way. Reports required types absent, required properties missing per entity, unmentioned types when unknown types are forbidden, entities with no @type, and blocks with no @context. Only JSON-LD is read, and that is stated rather than treated as conformant. Pay 130000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

contract.description: What the page is required to declare. An unknown property here is refused rather than ignored, since a typo in a contract is not a default.

forbid_unknown_types.description: Report any declared type the contract does not mention. Defaults to false.

required_properties.description: Per type, the properties every entity of that type must carry. A type that is absent is noted as not checked rather than counted as passing.

required_types.description: @type values at least one entity must carry.

html.description: The page whose structured data is audited. Raw HTML, at most 262144 bytes. Scripts are not executed, so anything rendered client-side is absent and said to be absent. Nothing is fetched: the caller supplies the bytes, which is what lets an arbitrary site be audited.

url.description: The URL the page was served under. Used to resolve relative links and to compare against the declared canonical. A wrong value produces wrong resolutions rather than silently relative ones.

name: structured_data_contract_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when the document was fully parsed and every declared requirement held.

entity_count.description: Entities after flattening @graph and nested entities.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Structured Data Contract Audit
